title: atenia garrettii
intro: Atenia garrettii, commonly known as the "Black Chia" or "Chia", is a plant native to the Andean region of South America. The health benefits of Atenia garrettii include its ability to provide sustained energy, support digestive health, and help with weight management due to its high fiber and omega-3 content. The therapeutic actions of Atenia garrettii include its use as a natural anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiotonic agent, which may help reduce inflammation, improve heart health, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Atenia garrettii include chia seeds, which are rich in alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), a type of omega-3 fatty acid, as well as other nutrients such as protein, fiber, and vitamins.
